title: Trust in the Lord with All Your Heart
speaker: Ryan Baird
summary: We trust God not only because he is all-powerful and all-knowing, but because he loves us completely. Bring him the big things and the little things.
exhortation: It really is a joy to trust in the Lord this morning. What peace and comfort to know that though we can't see around the next corner, let alone into the next day or year, our God knows the end from the beginning. He holds all our days in his hand. And we don't trust him simply because he is all-powerful and all-knowing, but because he loves us completely and always has our best in mind. Take some time today to meditate on that. It's a refreshment that gets deep into our bones, to the very core of who we are.

Imagine for a second that the richest man in the world called you out of the blue today and said, "I've got you covered for the rest of your life." How much comfort would you feel? That is what God has said to us, and God has far more resources. Beyond meeting our needs, he has given us his very self. The richest man on earth could die at any time or change his mind. But God is completely faithful and unchanging. He loves us completely and has promised never to leave us or forsake us.

So what is on your heart and mind that you need to bring to Jesus? It's time to go to him in prayer. Cast your burdens on the Lord, because he cares for you, and not just about the big things. He cares about the tiniest details too. So bring the little things to him as well.
prayer: Father, you are ready to receive the repentant. If anyone still has rebellious ways and sins of their youth lingering and clinging to them, I pray they would run to you for forgiveness.

Give us confidence and hope in you. Help us bring every little thing and every big thing to you this morning, and walk as children of God: not hanging our heads and moping, but as people who are redeemed and forgiven, with an inner hope that can't be crushed even in the middle of great trial and suffering. Thank you, Lord.
